description: This file implements the RemoveSource class, which is responsible for removing a media source of type AUDIO from a media pipeline, including clearing buffers, updating state flags, and sending flush events to the source element.

classes.name: RemoveSource
classes.description: A class that handles the removal of a media source, specifically for AUDIO type, by clearing buffers, updating flags, and sending flush events to the source element.

methods.name: RemoveSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RemoveSource object with context, client, gstWrapper, and media source type.

methods.name: ~RemoveSource
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of RemoveSource object destruction.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the removal of the media source by clearing buffers, updating flags, and sending flush events if the source is valid and of type AUDIO.
